description: This file is a shell script used for testing reftable compatibility between Git and JGit. It sets environment variables, checks prerequisites, and runs a series of tests involving repository initialization, commits, ref comparisons, and conversions.

methods.name: test_commit_jgit
methods.description: Creates a file, stages it with jgit, and commits it with a message.

methods.name: test_same_refs
methods.description: Compares the references between git and jgit to ensure they are the same.

methods.name: test_same_ref
methods.description: Compares the rev-parse output for a given ref between git and jgit.

methods.name: test_same_reflog
methods.description: Compares the reflogs between git and jgit for a given reference or references.
